verdict.rationale: Persona documents Persona-hosted UI options: a no-frontend-code Hosted Flow redirect, an iframe/modal Embedded Flow, and native mobile SDKs. Inquiries can be pre-created server-side via the API from templates that define screens and verifications, including Government ID plus Selfie. Results can be read through status webhooks or by polling the API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end hosted doc-plus-selfie flow.
